proof_body:
by
  intro p q _ _ hp hq hpq
  have hp1 := (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p).eq_two_or_odd.resolve_left hp
  have hq1 := (Fact.out : Nat.Prime q).eq_two_or_odd.resolve_left hq
  have h1 : (p - 1) / 2 = p / 2 := by omega
  have h2 : (q - 1) / 2 = q / 2 := by omega
  rw [h1, h2]
  exact legendreSym.quadratic_reciprocity hp hq hpq
target_source: ∀ (p q : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [Fact (Nat.Prime q)], p ≠ 2 → q ≠ 2 → p ≠ q → legendreSym q (p : ℤ) * legendreSym p (q : ℤ) = (-1) ^ ((p - 1) / 2 * ((q - 1) / 2))
